description: Smarte Strasse: Fahrzeugdurchfahrten is a dataset listed in Datenportal Basel-Stadt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Amt für Umwelt und Energie. Der Datensatz zeigt alle Durchfahrten von Fahrzeugen mit der dazugehörigen Zeitangabe. Weitere Informationen und Daten rund um das Projekt «Smarte Strasse» finden Sie unter den folgenden Links: Informationen zum Projekt «Smarte Strasse»: Genaue Standorte aller Sensoren (inkl. Coverage: Canton of Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Smarte Strasse, Auto, Verkehr, Verkehrszählung, Stau. The portal shows 587,596 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2024-02-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bs-ch-portal.
